summary: Edited finish.mjs and re-ran make.sh; v2.nbt is the previous version. The reviewers' name, "modern flat-roofed house on stilts", already matches the brief, so I didn't change the identity. I added age and speckled textures within the same colours, plus small details and a stepped roofline. Orphans fell from 15 to 0, and the check reports 0 floating and 0 unsupported blocks.
applied: 1. Visible age: a salt-grime course along the lower walls, calcite and polished_diorite speckle on the upper walls, pale_oak trapdoors mixed into the slat screen, and verdigris (oxidized_cut_copper) on the house-number panel and the pavilion clerestory band
2. Fewer colour families: parasol stripes cyan to white and light blue; the extra moss and copper hues I tried were dropped or kept to one verdigris accent
3. Livelier textures within the same colours: concrete speckle, mixed deck boards, sand blown onto the terrace, and verdigris against the white

4. Small details: striped awning over the tall north window, azalea planters flanking the door, a bench, three lantern posts on the path, an outdoor shower, towels on the balustrade, a lantern on the jetty

5. Roofline: pergola over the roof-terrace loungers, a quartz chimney stack with a cap, tinted-glass solar panels on a raised base, a lightning-rod mast. I also moved the two loungers that were misplaced inside the living room up onto the terrace
6. Stray blocks and grounding: removed the palm-frond droop tips (15 orphans to 0), thickened the frond tips, and added dune-grass tufts round the deck and steps
skipped: Close wall holes: the check reports 0 blank walls and 'wall gaps Few'; the remaining openings are windows, doors and the recessed porch, so I left them

Palette flags on oxidized_cut_copper (outlier) and the parasol's white-on-white stripes: kept, because the verdigris is deliberate and echoes the aqua glass, and the parasol still reads in the renders
Massing and wall relief: left as they were, per 'keep what works'
